visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a woman with short brown hair sitting at a wooden table in a dimly lit, warm restaurant. (2) The scene transitions to a digital interface of a messaging app shown on a plain background. It displays a text conversation in Traditional Chinese about inviting someone to eat sushi in Japan for a celebration. Small character icons and sticker elements appear at the bottom of the screen. (3) The woman is then seen standing in a brightly lit retail environment carrying a large patterned shopping bag. This is followed by her standing outside a restaurant entrance featuring a white noren curtain with black Japanese calligraphy, where she gestures towards the doorway with an inviting smile. (4) Inside the restaurant, three chefs wearing white professional uniforms and headbands are shown working behind a light-colored wooden sushi counter. They are meticulously preparing various ingredients and plates in a clean, minimalist kitchen environment under bright indoor lighting. (5) A series of close-up shots showcase high-quality sushi items: a piece of shrimp sushi, a slice of red tuna, and two pieces of nori-wrapped sushi topped with sea urchin and roe. Hands are shown picking up and presenting the food on ceramic plates. (6) The main character is seen eating a piece of sushi, her facial expression showing intense delight. She covers her mouth with her hand while chewing and later gives two thumbs up towards the camera alongside the sister character, whose face remains obscured. (7) The video concludes with a shot of a man and a small child sitting at a restaurant table with glasses of water. Finally, the man is shown walking with the child in an outdoor park area with green grass and modern buildings under clear natural daylight.
